# Selection Translation

Translate an English word, phrase or short passage into Chinese without leaving your writing or reading page. It works in Notes and Books, PDF/EPUB text, Workshop, Library and selectable interface text. It is intended for short selections, not whole-book translation.

## Translation connections and models

Open **Workshop → Translation Settings**.

| Connection mode | Configuration |
| --- | --- |
| **Use an existing AI connection** | Choose a service and one of the models already saved in AI Settings. The key and model name are reused. |
| **Separate translation connection** | Configure a dedicated service/key and translation model independently of the Chat model list. |

In reuse mode, add missing models in [AI Settings](ai-settings.md) first. In separate mode, choose SiliconFlow, OpenRouter or Others, supply the required connection details, and choose a model with **Refresh translation models** or enter its exact Model ID. Refresh retrieves the platform catalogue; access and prices still depend on your account.

![Translation settings using a saved model](assets/ee0c402b2fd894e2831cd49000f583d9d2352d4c0e972cfa3c6190ba4cc12c8a.png)

The example reuses a saved connection. You can instead choose a different model or key solely for translation.

## Translation prompt and connection test

Expand **Translation prompt** to inspect the translation instructions. The default asks for translation of the selected content; you can adjust terminology or wording preferences. These instructions belong to translation and do not change the response guidelines used by Chat.

Click **Save translation settings**, then **Test translation**. The test displays its sample source and translated result so you can check the connection. It uses the selected service and can incur a fee. Choose a model that responds quickly enough for short selections; a large reasoning model is not automatically a better fit for this task.

## Enabling translation and selecting text

1. Turn on **Translate** in the main sidebar, or press **Ctrl+Alt+T**. It starts off each time LanCarbon opens.
2. Select an English word, phrase or short passage. In an editor, select the characters inside the text field; in a reader, select readable text.
3. After the selection settles, the floating panel shows the original and its Chinese translation. Drag the header to move it; long source and translated text scroll independently.
4. Close the panel, turn off Translate or use the shortcut again to stop automatic translation on selection.

Password, API-key and connection-address fields are excluded. Scanned PDF text must first be recognized; see [Reading PDF and EPUB](../06-library/reading.md).

## Continuous translation across PDF pages

Select the first part of a passage and check **Continuous translation (Z)** in the translation panel. You can also press **Z** while a PDF text selection is active; this shortcut does not apply while typing in an editor or input field. Scroll to the next page and select the rest. The panel appends the new selection in selection order and translates the combined original, rather than joining separate translations.

The first translation may already have started. Each new selection requests a translation of the combined passage unless a cached result matches. The complete passage is limited to 1,600 characters or 250 words; an oversized addition is rejected without discarding the existing passage. Use **New passage** to clear the source and start another passage. Uncheck continuous translation to replace the source with each new selection. Scrolling within a PDF keeps the passage; switching documents or workspaces clears it and turns continuous mode off.

## Cached translations and usage

Saved translation results can be reused without repeating the same request when the text and relevant settings match. **Clear translation cache** removes saved translations, not your source text. Usage records and shared-account balance settings are described in [Usage, Costs and Balances](usage.md).

---

# 选词翻译

无需离开当前写作或阅读页面，就能把英文单词、词组或短段落翻译成中文。它适用于 Notes、Books、PDF／EPUB 文字、Workshop、Library 和可选取的界面文字，主要用于短内容，不是整本书的批量翻译工具。

## 翻译连接与模型

打开 **Workshop → Translation Settings**。

| 连接模式 | 配置方法 |
| --- | --- |
| **Use an existing AI connection** | 选择服务及 AI Settings 已保存的模型，复用密钥和模型名称。 |
| **Separate translation connection** | 单独配置翻译服务、密钥和模型，与聊天模型列表独立。 |

复用模式下，缺少的模型先到 [AI Settings](ai-settings.md) 添加。独立模式下选择 SiliconFlow、OpenRouter 或 Others，填写连接信息，再通过 **Refresh translation models** 选择模型或手填准确的 Model ID。刷新得到的是平台目录，实际权限和价格仍取决于账户。

![复用已有模型的翻译设置](assets/ee0c402b2fd894e2831cd49000f583d9d2352d4c0e972cfa3c6190ba4cc12c8a.png)

图中复用了已有连接。也可以为翻译单独选择其他模型或密钥。

## 翻译提示词与连接测试

展开 **Translation prompt** 查看翻译指令。默认要求翻译选中的内容，可按需调整术语或表达偏好。这里的指令只用于翻译，不会改变 Chat 的回答规范。

点击 **Save translation settings**，再点击 **Test translation**。测试会显示示例原文及翻译结果，方便检查连接；它使用选定服务，可能产生费用。短选词需要合适的响应速度，大型推理模型不一定更适合这一任务。

## 开启翻译并选取文字

1. 开启主侧栏 **Translate**，或按 **Ctrl+Alt+T**。每次启动 LanCarbon 时默认关闭。
2. 选取英文单词、词组或短段落。编辑器中可以选择输入框内的字符；阅读器中选择可读取的文字。
3. 选取稳定后，浮窗显示原文和中文。拖动标题栏可以移动浮窗；长原文与长译文分别滚动。
4. 关闭浮窗、关闭 Translate，或再次按快捷键，即可停止选词自动翻译。

密码、API Key 和接口地址字段不参与翻译。扫描 PDF 需要先识别文字，参见[阅读 PDF 与 EPUB](../06-library/reading.md)。

## 翻译缓存与用量

当选中文字及相关设置相同时，已保存的翻译结果可以复用，避免重复请求。**Clear translation cache** 清理已保存译文，不删除原文。用量记录与共享账户余额设置见[用量、费用与余额](usage.md)。


## PDF 跨页连续翻译

选中一段话的前半部分，在翻译浮窗勾选 **Continuous translation (Z)**。PDF 文字选区有效时也可按 **Z** 切换；在编辑器或输入框打字时不会触发这个快捷键。滚动到下一页，再选后半部分。浮窗按选取顺序追加原文并整体翻译，不是把两段译文拼在一起。

第一段的翻译可能已经开始。每次新选取都会请求翻译合并后的完整内容，命中缓存时复用结果。累计内容限 1,600 个字符或 250 个词，超限追加会被拒绝，但不会丢掉已有原文。点击 **New passage** 清空并开始另一段；取消连续模式后，每次选取替换当前原文。在同一 PDF 内滚动会保留累计内容；切换文档或工作区会清空并关闭连续模式。

notes.title: Reading PDF and EPUB
notes.content:
# Reading PDF and EPUB

## Opening documents and switching tabs

In Library, double-click a PDF or EPUB, or choose **Open**. You can also open a linked document from a Note or Book's **Preview** or **Resources** panel. The same document shares its reading position across these entry points.

Up to **ten documents** can remain open in the top tab bar. Click a tab to switch, or its close button to release it. Opening the same document selects its existing tab. If ten tabs are already open, close one before opening another. **Workspace** returns to the previous writing or Library page without closing your tabs. The menu button at the left shows or hides the main sidebar.

## PDF navigation and search

Use the page number and previous/next controls to move through the document. **Pages / Contents** gives you thumbnails and the document's own outline, where available. **Fit width**, **Fit page** and zoom adapt the page to the reading area. **Find in PDF**, also available with **Ctrl+F**, searches readable text and moves between matches.

Select text to copy it or use translation. Reading position and zoom are remembered for the document. Renaming or moving it within Library keeps that identity. If an external edit produces a new version while the document is open, use **Reload latest version** when you are ready to read the changed contents.

## Text recognition in scanned PDFs

A scanned page is an image rather than selectable text. When an opened page has no usable text layer, LanCarbon recognizes English and Simplified Chinese locally. Use the **OCR** menu for additional control:

| Action | When to use it |
| --- | --- |
| **Recognize page** | Retry the current page, or replace an incorrect embedded text layer with recognition results for reading. |
| **Recognize PDF** | Prepare the document for search and selection, up to 500 pages. Readable embedded text and completed recognition results are reused. |
| **Stop OCR** | Stop the current reading task; completed pages remain available. |

After recognition, select or copy text and use **Find in PDF** as usual. To search an entire scanned document, recognize the PDF first: image text on unprocessed pages cannot yet be searched. Document questions also prepare selected scans automatically. If Chat prepared pages after the reader was opened, reopen the PDF or use **Recognize PDF** to refresh the text layer.

OCR resources are included with LanCarbon. Recognition needs no additional API Key and uses no model tokens. It does not rewrite your PDF. Recognition can misread numbers, tables, formulas or unusual layouts, so compare important details with the original page. It is text recognition, not a complete reconstruction of table or formula structure.

## EPUB navigation and display

Use **Contents** to choose a chapter or heading. Previous/next buttons switch chapters; **Find in EPUB** searches the book. Adjust font size, line spacing and reading width for comfortable reading. Text, images and tables use LanCarbon's reading theme.

The reader supports reflowable EPUB 2/3 documents. DRM, fixed-layout books, scripts, audio and video are not supported by this reader. Use **Open externally** if a book needs its original reader or publisher-specific presentation.

## Highlights, underlines and comments

Select text, then choose **Highlight**, **Underline** or **Comment** in the fixed top reading toolbar, beside **OCR** in PDF or the display controls in EPUB. These buttons are available after you select text. **Annotations** is beside **Pages / Contents** (or **Contents** in EPUB). Choose a color and optionally enter **My comment**, then click **Save annotation**. Comment-only marks require comment text and appear as a dotted underline. Click a mark to reopen it, or use **Annotations** to browse saved excerpts and comments in document order. Use **Edit**, on the same row as the style and color, to change the style, color or comment, or to delete the annotation. Close the annotations panel when you want more space to read.

Click an item's location in the list to return to its passage. PDF locations are actual file pages, counted from the first page; printed page labels may differ. EPUB locations identify the chapter and, where available, the paragraph. PDF marks follow zoom and EPUB marks follow text reflow. Scans need a usable OCR text layer before selection is possible.

Annotations are saved automatically after **Save annotation**, in independent JSON files under **Data/Library/Annotations** within your configured Data Location. Original PDF/EPUB files are not modified. Include this folder and your original Library files in backups. Renaming or moving a file inside Library preserves its identity; importing an unrelated copy does not transfer annotations. If the original changes, earlier annotations remain available in the list with a file-version warning. Their old positions are not applied to the changed original; reload and add new annotations to the new version.

## Exporting annotations to a Note

In **Annotations**, choose **Export all to Note**, or tick individual entries and choose **Export selected**. Review the confirmation and click **Create new Note**. The new Note contains the source filename, export time, each original excerpt, any comment, its location and a **Return to original** link. Highlight-only entries omit the comment section.

The Note is an editable snapshot. Changes to it do not alter the annotations, and later annotation edits do not update the Note. Exporting again creates a new Note and never overwrites an earlier one; when an existing exported Note is found, the confirmation reminds you of it. Return links open the passage in LanCarbon while the source and annotation remain available. If the annotation was deleted or the original changed, LanCarbon explains why that saved location cannot be used. The exported excerpt and written location remain readable. These links are local-app links, not public website links.

This action exports a Note, not a PDF or EPUB with embedded annotations.

## Translation while reading

Configure translation once in [Translation Settings](../07-workshop/translation.md), then turn on **Translate** or press **Ctrl+Alt+T**. Selecting an English word, phrase or short passage displays its Chinese translation. The source and translation scroll separately inside the floating panel. Close the panel or turn off Translate when you want ordinary selection without translation requests.

## Opening files in external applications

**Open externally**, beside the reader's search field, uses the system's default application. This is also how ordinary resources such as images, TXT and Word files are opened. External edits are handled as described under [External editing and file versions](management.md).

## The reading sidebar

**Annotations** opens the shared right sidebar beside the document. The reading area resizes to leave room for the list. Opening it closes the left workspace list and the reader's Pages / Contents. Opening either left-hand list closes Annotations. Close the right sidebar to use the full reading width. Selecting a Note or Book tab changes the right sidebar to that page's AI Chat.

---

# 阅读 PDF 与 EPUB

## 打开文档与切换文件

在 Library 中双击 PDF 或 EPUB，或点击 **Open**。也可以从 Note、Book 的 **Preview** 附件链接或 **Resources** 面板打开。不同入口打开的同一文档共用阅读进度。

顶部标签栏最多同时保留 **十个文档**。点击标签切换，点击关闭按钮关闭该文件。重复打开同一文档会转到已有标签；已有十个标签时，先关闭一个再打开新文件。**Workspace** 返回此前的写作或 Library 页面，不关闭标签。左侧菜单按钮用于展开或收起主侧栏。

## PDF 导航与搜索

使用页码和前后翻页按钮移动到目标页面。**Pages / Contents** 显示缩略图以及文档自身提供的目录。**Fit width**、**Fit page** 与缩放用于调整阅读大小。**Find in PDF** 或 **Ctrl+F** 搜索可读取的文字，并在匹配位置之间跳转。

选中文字后可以复制或翻译。软件会记住文档的阅读位置和缩放；在 Library 中改名、移动不会改变文档身份。阅读期间，如果外部编辑产生新版本，可以在需要时使用 **Reload latest version** 加载更新内容。

## 扫描 PDF 的文字识别

扫描页本质上是图片，不一定能直接选中文字。打开的页面没有可用文字层时，LanCarbon 会在本地识别英文和简体中文。**OCR** 菜单提供以下操作：

| 操作 | 适用情形 |
| --- | --- |
| **Recognize page** | 重新识别当前页，或用识别结果替代错误的内嵌文字层进行阅读。 |
| **Recognize PDF** | 为全篇搜索和选词准备文字，最多处理 500 页；复用可读的内嵌文字和已完成的识别结果。 |
| **Stop OCR** | 停止当前阅读识别任务，已完成页面仍可使用。 |

完成后可以像普通 PDF 一样选取、复制文字和使用 **Find in PDF**。搜索整份扫描文档前，先执行 Recognize PDF；尚未处理的图片文字还不能搜索。资料问答也会自动准备选定的扫描件。如果 Chat 在阅读器打开后识别了更多页面，可重新打开 PDF 或使用 Recognize PDF 刷新文字层。

OCR 识别资源随软件提供，不需要额外 API Key，也不消耗模型 tokens；识别不会改写 PDF 原件。数字、表格、公式或特殊版式可能识别不准，重要内容应对照原页。它提供文字识别，不保证完整还原表格和公式结构。

## EPUB 导航与显示

通过 **Contents** 选择章节或标题，前后按钮切换章节，**Find in EPUB** 搜索全书。可以调整字号、行距和阅读宽度。文字、图片和表格使用 LanCarbon 的阅读主题。

内置阅读器支持可重排的 EPUB 2／3，不支持 DRM、固定版式、脚本、音频和视频。需要专用阅读器或原出版社版式时，可使用 **Open externally**。

## 高亮、划线与文字批注

选中文字后，使用顶部固定阅读工具栏（PDF 中位于 **OCR** 旁，EPUB 中位于显示设置旁）选择 **Highlight**（高亮）、**Underline**（划线）或 **Comment**（评论）。未选择有效原文时，三个按钮不可用。**Annotations** 位于 **Pages / Contents**（EPUB 中为 **Contents**）旁。选择颜色，按需填写 **My comment**，再点击 **Save annotation** 保存。仅评论模式必须填写文字，原文处显示点状下划线。点击原文标记可以重新打开批注；**Annotations** 列表按原文顺序显示摘录和评论。类型和颜色同行右侧的 **Edit** 用于修改样式、颜色和评论，也可在编辑窗口内删除批注；需要更大阅读空间时关闭批注面板。

点击列表中的位置返回原文。PDF 使用从文件第一页开始计数的实际页码，可能与印刷页码不同；EPUB 使用章节，能够识别时附带段落序号。PDF 标记随缩放调整，EPUB 标记随文字重排调整。扫描 PDF 需要先生成可用的 OCR 文字层，才能选取文字。

点击 **Save annotation** 后，批注保存为当前 Data Location 下 **Data/Library/Annotations** 对应位置的独立 JSON 文件，不改写 PDF／EPUB 原件。备份时同时保留批注目录和 Library 原文件。在 Library 内改名或移动会保留文档身份；重新导入无关联副本不会自动转移批注。原文件内容变化后，旧批注仍显示在列表中并提示文件版本不同，不将旧位置套用到新内容上。重新加载后可为新版本添加批注。

## 将批注导出为 Note

在 **Annotations** 中选择 **Export all to Note**；也可以先勾选条目，再选择 **Export selected**。查看确认说明，点击 **Create new Note**。新笔记包含原文件名、导出时间、每条原文摘录、填写的评论、原文位置及 **Return to original** 返回链接。只有高亮或划线而未填写评论时，不生成空评论段落。

Note 是可编辑快照：修改 Note 不会修改原批注，之后修改批注也不会自动改写 Note。重复导出创建新 Note，不覆盖既有笔记；检测到已导出的 Note 时，确认窗口会提醒。原文件和批注仍可用时，可在 LanCarbon 中点击返回链接定位原文；如果批注已删除或原文版本改变，会说明不能使用该位置的原因。摘录和文字形式的位置仍保留在笔记里。返回链接供软件内部使用，不是公开网页链接。

此操作导出普通 Note，不生成内嵌批注的 PDF 或 EPUB 文件。

## 阅读时翻译

先在[翻译设置](../07-workshop/translation.md)完成一次配置，再开启 **Translate** 或按 **Ctrl+Alt+T**。选取英文单词、词组或短段落后，浮窗会显示中文；原文与译文分别滚动。只想普通选词时，关闭浮窗或 Translate，避免触发翻译请求。

## 使用外部软件

阅读器搜索框旁的 **Open externally** 使用系统默认程序。图片、TXT、Word 等普通资源也使用默认程序打开。外部修改的保存方式见[外部编辑与文件版本](management.md)。

## 阅读侧栏

**Annotations** 在文档右侧打开统一侧栏，正文区域相应调整宽度，为列表留出空间。打开它会收起左侧工作区列表及阅读器的 Pages / Contents；打开任一左侧列表会收起批注。关闭右侧栏后恢复完整阅读宽度。切换到 Note 或 Book 标签时，右侧栏会改为该页面的 AI Chat。

notes.title: Questions about Your Knowledge Library
notes.content:
# Questions about Your Knowledge Library

Use source-based Chat to locate information, explain a passage, compare documents and develop reading notes. It brings together Library documents and your own Notes and Book pages. This is often called retrieval-augmented generation, or RAG; you do not need to manage an index before asking your first question.

Configure a Chat model first. The current full-text question workflow prepares readable source text locally and sends it, your question and relevant conversation context to that model. **Embedding and Rerank are not prerequisites for this workflow.** It does not perform live web searches or automatically obtain new papers.

## Source selection

Open a Chat and select **Choose sources** immediately above the message box.

| Source | How to select it |
| --- | --- |
| **Notes** | Choose individual writing notes. |
| **Books** | Expand a Book into chapters and pages; select a whole Book, a chapter or individual pages. |
| **Library** | Expand folders and subfolders, then select documents or a folder. |

![Selecting sources for a conversation](assets/2d1d4b5aeacbc660195824c0657ba89614d85b1d2ea59a356ba69d5162df05be.png)

A sample source selection. Expanding a branch and selecting its contents are separate actions.

Use the arrows to expand a branch and the checkboxes to select it. Partial selection is shown on parent branches. Searching keeps matching items visible with their parent locations. **Include linked attachments** also follows supported attachments referenced by the selected writing. **Show built-in content** makes the official tutorial available as a source; it is hidden by default.

The selection belongs to this chat. Whole-Book and folder selections can include later additions; individual page choices keep their selected pages. Use **Clear sources** for ordinary Chat without attached knowledge sources. **Import PDF / EPUB**, or dropping files into Chat, adds or reuses Library documents and selects them for this conversation.

There is no fixed 20-source limit for a chat. The Library's 20-file import batch limit is a different rule. Actual source preparation and sending still have size and model-context limits. If LanCarbon reports that the selection is too large, narrow it to the documents relevant to your question or start a fresh conversation. Selecting the entire library is rarely necessary.

## Questions and follow-up context

After choosing sources, send a concrete question. Preparation happens automatically. PDFs and reflowable EPUBs are parsed, and scanned PDF pages may need [OCR](../06-library/reading.md). Large scans take longer to prepare than text documents.

For two papers on a related subject, a useful conversation might be:

1. “What research question does each paper answer, and what do they measure?”
2. “Why do their estimates differ? Compare their assumptions and study boundaries.”
3. “Explain the equation used in the second paper and define each variable.”
4. “Which findings could support a short comparison paragraph in my literature review?”

You do not need a rigid question format. Use names or titles when a pronoun such as “that paper” would be ambiguous. Keep a follow-up in the same chat when it depends on the preceding exchange. Start a new chat for an unrelated topic or a clean comparison of models.

## Citations and original sources

Source-linked answers include citations and an **Evidence** area. Expand it to inspect passages and use **Open source** or the citation link to return to the relevant document page, EPUB location or writing page. This connects the answer to material you can read yourself.

Check consequential numbers, units, formula variables and the parties being compared against the original. An excerpt citation identifies supporting material; it does not certify every interpretation in the answer. OCR labels identify recognized text that may need closer inspection. If a source is missing or unreadable, repair or replace it before relying on that part of an answer.

Some monetary calculations show an original amount alongside a local conversion or calculation. **Check amounts** can identify calculations that could not be completed. These tools check amount matching and arithmetic; they do not decide whether the chosen scenario or economic entity is the right one.

## Saving reading notes

Use **Export to Note** to save the conversation, optionally including Thinking and cited passages. Edit the result into your own reading note, keep its source references and add it to an appropriate Book. See [Working with AI Chat](chat.md) for export options.

## Data sent and request costs

Source preparation and OCR run locally, but answering sends selected readable material to your chosen AI service. Full-text questions can use substantially more input tokens than ordinary Chat, and follow-ups can send source material again. Choose a focused scope and inspect [Usage](usage.md) when learning how much your reading sessions cost.

---

# 基于个人知识库提问

资料问答用于定位信息、解释段落、比较文档与整理阅读笔记。来源既可以是 Library 文献，也可以是自己的 Notes 和 Book 页面。这类能力通常称为检索增强生成，即 RAG；开始提问前不需要先手动管理索引。

首先配置一个 Chat 模型。当前全文问答流程在本地准备可读的来源文字，再将文字、问题和相关对话上下文发送给该模型。**Embedding 和 Rerank 不是此流程的使用前提**。它不会执行实时联网搜索，也不会自动获取新文献。

## 资料来源与选择范围

打开 Chat，点击消息输入框正上方的 **Choose sources**。

| 来源 | 选择方式 |
| --- | --- |
| **Notes** | 选择独立笔记。 |
| **Books** | 逐层展开 Book、章节和页面，可以选择整本书、章节或单页。 |
| **Library** | 展开文件夹与子文件夹，选择文档或整个文件夹。 |

![为聊天选择资料来源](assets/2d1d4b5aeacbc660195824c0657ba89614d85b1d2ea59a356ba69d5162df05be.png)

示例来源选择界面。展开目录与勾选其中内容是不同操作。

点击箭头展开目录，使用选择框勾选；只选中部分内容时，上级目录显示部分选中状态。搜索会保留匹配内容及其上级位置。**Include linked attachments** 同时纳入选定写作内容所引用的受支持附件。内置教程默认不参与选择，开启 **Show built-in content** 后才会显示。

来源范围属于当前聊天。整本 Book 或整个文件夹的选择可以纳入后来新增内容；单独勾选页面时保留选定页面。**Clear sources** 清除来源，恢复不附加知识资料的普通聊天。**Import PDF / EPUB** 或向 Chat 拖入文件，会导入或复用 Library 文档，并把它们加入当前聊天来源。

聊天没有固定的 20 项来源限制；Library 每批导入 20 个文件是另一条规则。但资料准备、发送体积和模型上下文仍有容量限制。软件提示范围过大时，请缩小到与问题相关的资料，或另开聊天。通常无需把整个资料库全部选上。

## 提问与追问

选择来源后发送具体问题，软件会自动准备资料。PDF 与可重排 EPUB 会提取文字，扫描 PDF 可能需要 [OCR](../06-library/reading.md)。大型扫描件的准备时间通常长于文字文档。

比较两篇相关论文时，可以这样进行多轮对话：

1. “两篇文章分别回答什么研究问题，衡量的对象是什么？”
2. “为什么估计结果不同？比较它们的假设和研究边界。”
3. “解释第二篇文章使用的公式，并说明各变量含义。”
4. “哪些结果适合放进文献综述中的一段比较？”

不需要严格的提问模板。“那篇文章”等指代不清时，使用作者或标题。依赖前文的追问留在同一聊天；无关主题或需要独立比较模型时，新建聊天更清楚。

## 引用与原文定位

资料回答提供来源引用和 **Evidence** 区域。展开后查看原文片段，通过 **Open source** 或引用链接返回对应 PDF 页、EPUB 位置或写作页面，使回答与可直接阅读的材料相连。

对结论影响较大的数字、单位、公式变量和比较主体，应回到原文检查。引用标识提供支持材料，不代表回答中的所有解释都经过认证。OCR 标识说明片段来自文字识别，需要时更仔细核对；来源缺失或无法读取时，先修复或替换该来源。

部分金额计算会同时显示原始金额和本地换算或计算结果。**Check amounts** 可以指出未能完成的计算。这些工具检查金额匹配与算术，不负责判断所选情景或经济主体是否正确。

## 保存阅读笔记

使用 **Export to Note** 保存对话，可按需包含 Thinking 和引用片段。将结果编辑为自己的阅读笔记，保留来源，再加入合适的 Book。导出选项见[使用 AI Chat](chat.md)。

## 发送内容与请求费用

资料准备和 OCR 在本地运行，但生成回答时会将选定的可读材料发送给你配置的 AI 服务。全文问答的输入 Token 可能明显多于普通聊天，追问也可能再次发送资料。初次使用时，选择聚焦的来源范围，并结合 [Usage](usage.md)了解阅读对话的实际用量。

notes.title: 7. Workshop
notes.content:
# Using Workshop

Workshop provides AI Chat, selection translation, and usage and cost tracking. This section explains service and model configuration, conversation management, translation settings, and the records used to estimate costs and account balances.

Chat can also use selected Library documents, Notes and Book pages to answer questions and compare material. Source citations lead back to the original content, and conversations can be exported as PDF or saved as editable Notes.

---

# 使用 Workshop

Workshop 提供 AI Chat、选词翻译，以及用量和费用统计。本节介绍服务与模型配置、聊天管理、翻译设置，以及费用和账户余额的记录方式。

Chat 也可以使用选定的 Library 文档、Notes 和 Book 页面回答问题或比较资料。通过来源引用可以返回原文；对话结果可以导出为 PDF，或保存为可继续编辑的 Note。
